series: trendwatching.com annual consumer trends (free Trend Briefing)
title: 11 CRUCIAL CONSUMER TRENDS FOR 2011
notes: December 2010 Trend Briefing (first archived 2010-12-03). Labels and quotes from the briefing's numbered overview, whose one-line summaries end in '...' (ellipsis dropped from quotes). Item 12 'NEED MORE?' is a promotion, not a trend. target_year 2011 from the title.

entries.label: RANDOM ACTS OF KINDNESS
entries.quote: In 2011, there will be no excuses left not to be kind as a brand.
entries.subject: Brand kindness and surprise gestures

entries.label: URBANOMICS
entries.quote: Are you ready for hundreds of millions of more daring, more experienced consumers? And that's just one side effect of rapid global urbanization
entries.subject: Urbanization and urban consumers

entries.label: PRICING PANDEMONIUM
entries.quote: Flash sales, group buying, GPS-driven deals: in 2011 pricing will never be the same
entries.subject: Dynamic and deal-driven pricing

entries.label: MADE FOR CHINA (IF NOT BRIC)
entries.quote: In 2011, expect an increasing number of 'Western' brands to launch new products or even new brands dedicated (if not paying proper respect) to consumers in emerging markets
entries.subject: Products designed for emerging-market consumers

entries.label: ONLINE STATUS SYMBOLS
entries.quote: In 2011, you can’t go wrong supplying your (online-loving) customers with any kind of symbol, virtual or 'real world', that helps them display to peers their online contributions, creations or popularity
entries.subject: Online status markers

entries.label: WELLTHY
entries.quote: growing numbers of consumers will expect health products and services in 2011 to prevent misery (if not improve their quality of life), rather than merely treating illnesses and ailments
entries.subject: Preventive health and wellness

entries.label: SOCIAL-LITES AND TWINSUMERS
entries.quote: SOCIAL-LITES are all about discovery, as consumers become curators; actively broadcasting, remixing, compiling, commenting, sharing and recommending content, products, purchases, experiences to both their friends and wider audiences
entries.subject: Consumers as curators and taste-matched recommendation

entries.label: EMERGING GENEROSITY
entries.quote: In 2011, brands and wealthy individuals from emerging markets (yes, especially China) will increasingly be expected to give, donate, care and sympathize versus just sell and take.
entries.subject: Giving by emerging-market brands and wealthy individuals

entries.label: PLANNED SPONTANEITY
entries.subject: Last-minute, mobile-enabled planning
entries.note: Recycled label: PLANNED SPONTANEITY was a 2002-2003 monthly briefing.

entries.label: ECO SUPERIOR
entries.quote: When it comes to 'green consumption' in 2011, expect a rise in ECO-SUPERIOR products: products that are not only eco-friendly, but superior to polluting incumbents in every possible way
entries.subject: Eco products that outperform incumbents
entries.note: Heading prints 'ECO SUPERIOR'; the text prints 'ECO-SUPERIOR'.

entries.label: OWNER-LESS
entries.quote: 2011 could be the year when sharing and renting really tips into mainstream consumer consciousness
entries.subject: Sharing and renting instead of owning
